Lord '''Hamarashle''' is a [[Cairhienin]] lord. 

== Activities ==
Queen [[Elayne Trakand]] brings Lord Hamarashle and a small group of Cairhienin nobles to [[Caemlyn]] where she first demonstrates her newly created [[Dragon]]s. He then witnesses [[Arymilla Marne]], [[Elenia Sarand]] and [[Naean Arawn]] have their lands and titles stripped by Elayne. These lands are offered to [[Bertome Saighan]] and [[Lorstrum Aesnan]] on the condition that they support her ascension to the [[Sun Throne]].
